title: Social media impersonation
summary: An account copies a known person or organization and asks for help, money, or codes.
scenario: The profile looks familiar but the request is unusual or comes through a new account.
warning_signs: Request for secrecy or urgent help
Payment or code request unlike normal contact
safe_actions: Verify with the person through a known channel
Do not share account credentials or codes
Report or block only after preserving needed evidence
recovery_guidance: Secure your account if you interacted with the copy
Tell the real contact through a trusted route
reporting_guidance: Keep the profile link and messages
Use the platform's reporting flow opened directly
prevention_tips: A familiar name or photo is not authentication
Use a second channel for unusual requests
false_positive_notes: People can change accounts or devices; independent confirmation resolves the ambiguity.
